result.rationale: The migration inserts old setting values verbatim: `INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`. The old setting format included protocol/path (specs in this diff show values like 'http://discourse.org' and 'https://example.com/1234' were valid), and the old lookup stripped schemes, but the new `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` matches only `lower(host) = uri.host`. No normalization is applied in the migration (the model's `before_validation` stripping is bypassed by raw SQL inserts), so migrated rows like 'http://discourse.org' will never match, breaking existing embeds/feed
